liability.quote: A claim that Academic Misconduct has been committed unintentionally or accidentally is no defence.

“Poor Academic Practice” – is judged to be a minor breach of standard academic conventions, such as poorly attributed or incorrect referencing to a limited extent, or over-reliance on referenced material.

detection.quote: Ensure that everything goes through Turnitin.
Tutors must recognise that the % similarity score is not an absolute identifier of academic misconduct.
In identifying academic misconduct, it is important to use academic judgement appropriately, and that where academic judgement is made it must be evidence-based.
In cases where it is difficult to document evidence of academic misconduct a viva voce examination will be convened by the Academic Misconduct Co-ordinator.

process.quote: Students are able to approach a member of staff, e.g. their Programme Manager, Lecturer, or Academic Misconduct Co-ordinator, to discuss informally any concerns
In all other cases the allegation of academic misconduct will be referred to the Academic Misconduct Investigation Panel.

The Academic Misconduct Co-ordinator shall undertake an investigation into the allegation to determine whether or not there is sufficient evidence of academic misconduct to proceed with the allegation.
The student will be asked to respond to the allegation, normally within 14 days, either accepting or denying the allegation of academic misconduct.
the Panel may decide to require the student to attend a Formal Panel meeting in person.
the University reserves the right to proceed with such a meeting in the absence of the student, subject to the student having been properly notified of the date and time of the meeting.
All students will have the right to be accompanied by a person of their choosing at any meeting associated with the Academic Misconduct process
If the student is dissatisfied with the outcome of the formal stage, they may be able to request a review.
The Academic Misconduct Investigation Panel shall normally meet within 30 days of receipt of the allegation.
The standard of proof to be applied is “on the balance of probabilities”.
the outcome is noted on the student’s record and the student may be placed on a monitoring system such as Academic Probation.
